PhD - Doctorate
The Department of Environmental Sciences offers opportunities to pursue doctorates in the following PhD subjects:
Botany
Geography
Geosciences
Prehistory and Archaeological Science
Environmental Sciences
Zoology
A doctorate can only be taken up in consultation and agreement with the respective professor.
PhD students can choose one of several doctoral programs:
PhD Program Environmental Sciences (including the possibility to participate in the Water-Earth Systems PhD School)
PhD Program in Science and Policy of Zurich-Basel Plant Science Center (PSC)
PhD Program in Plant Sciences of Zurich-Basel Plant Science Center (PSC)
The doctoral students belong to Group III of the Departmental Assembly.
Current PhD and PostDoc representatives in the Department Committee are Marina Garrido Priego, Luis Junghans, Laura Rindlisbacher and Benjamin Walter.
